about: P2-3 morning digest corpus (Option A: digest-first, no web). A hand-written Tuesday morning over fixture calendar days, mail, and notes, mirroring DigestSelfTest.fullFixture(), plus the silence case. Every section of the digest anatomy is exercised: masthead with edition/date/city, Today with an overlap callout, a 7-day week grid, per-person desks, dated watch items, Around Town from a place-bearing item, mail/notes items each with source and date, and Talk at the Table questions. Weather is absent, so the digest omits it; the silence fixture has nothing anywhere and must render exactly NOTHING_TO_REPORT. Synthetic people and places only; no real meeting is committed. Run with: NextNotes --selftest-digest (dispatch snippet returned with the implementation; NextNotesApp.swift itself is never edited by the digest epic).
